intro: Races coming up for our junior runners. Tap Add to my calendar to save one to your phone.
contact: Questions? Ask a coach at training, or message the parents' WhatsApp group. Always check the organiser's own page before you travel.

events.name: BeckBusters 2km Fun Run
events.venue: Bishop Monkton Primary School, St Johns Road, Bishop Monkton, HG3 3QW
events.notes: Enter in advance - there are no entries on the day, and places are limited. The fun run goes off before the 10km. Under 8s must be accompanied by an adult, who does not need to enter or pay. Chip timed, medal for every finisher. Start time not published yet - check the entry page.

events.name: English Schools Fell Running Championships
events.venue: Sedbergh School, Lupton Fields, Sedbergh, LA10 5AB
events.distance: 3.5km (Y7) / 4.9km (Y8 and Y9) / 6.3km (Y10 and Y11) / 7.3km (Y12 and Y13)
events.notes: Entries usually go through your school, so let them know if you want to run. First race 11:00 (Y7), then 11:30, 12:15 and 13:15. Prizes at 14:30. Fell or trail shoes, waterproof top, hat and gloves are compulsory - no kit, no run.

events.name: Wharfedale Harriers Quarry Runs
events.ageGroups: U10 to U18, minimum age 6 on the day. Ages are taken as at 31 December 2026
events.notes: Registration from 9:30 at the cricket hut, West End Cricket Club, Penistone Hill. First race 10:30 for U10s, the rest follow on. Goody bag for every runner, prizes for the top three in each age group and for fancy dress.
